notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Colossification attached to the same creature.
The creature with Elemental Mastery and Colossification attached does not have summoning sickness.
description:
During the end step before your turn, activate the creature with Colossification and Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least twenty 1/1 Elementals with haste.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.
